content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, and it's usually a habit more than a problem. Tonight, when he wakes, pause a minute or two before going in. If he's not truly upset, keep it short and boring: low voice, a quick pat, no lights, no picking up, and leave while he's still a bit awake. Doing the same thing at both wakings is what teaches him he can settle himself.
